camel_example: aliyun iot UnsubscribeTopic --region cn-hangzhou --Topic.1 'example-string' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName device1
description_en: Unsubscribes a specified device from a specified topic
description_zh: 调用接口UnsubscribeTopic为指定设备取消已订阅的指定Topic
kebab_example: aliyun iot unsubscribe-topic --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name device1 --topic example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnsubscribeTopic

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
